blocking.problem:
An unrelated non-permutation gate erases known-clean surrounding workspace from borrow analysis. Exact memoryless ptr_width=32 signature: {"abi":"0.8","args":[],"bounds":[],"in":[],"kind":"action","mem":[],"mut":[1],"tier":"q"}. Function:
action @a (t:wire mut) () () () ()
^entry():
c = qalloc any 1
h t
b = qborrow any 1
cx c b
qreturn b
h t
qfree c
The independently computed interface/closure hash is ba813954a842962eecd96263d6dbe2f549f7f8d4c99241c660f0a3c7626cf10a; with that stored hash object_hash is db747f53ae732bd2cef0eeeaed48b8bb2a523dc74f53b38d2876601a3760445f. hash, check, run-action a --mut 1 and reverse a --mut 1 all exit 1 with empty stdout and §5.6: qreturn does not restore borrowed wire v2_0. Hand: c is always |0>, hence CX(c,b) is identity at this lifetime for every unknown/entangled b; H(t);H(t)=I and c is freed clean. Removing both H instructions accepts and runs/reverses as identity. An independent in-memory harness bypassing only parse admission executes the H-separated body as exact identity in each direction on all four t,b basis pairs, superposition, and b entangled with an untouched reference. decide_frames partitions at Other(H t), then factorises initializes c as a free variable because its Alloc lies in the preceding run. No certificate or budget is involved.
blocking.fix: Change src/borrow.rs::Object::decide_frames/factorises and their analysis-state plumbing. §4.3 says qalloc produces "n clean wires"; §5.2 domain D specifies "qalloc'ed wires at 0"; §14.2 says "qalloc tensors |0⟩"; §5.6 requires the frame to satisfy "P_F = P′ ⊗ I_B". Carry established facts about still-live, untouched workspace across a non-permutation boundary, invalidating facts affected by that operation while keeping fresh borrowed entries independent and preserving the mandatory permutation-only borrowed-touch check. H on t must not make c arbitrary. Add the exact fixture to tests/r1_borrow.rs and tests/cli_xam.rs: parse/hash/check must accept; forward and adjoint at t=0/1 and a superposition must preserve t; reverse must report equals_entry=true; library execution must preserve b entangled with an external reference. Also put H after qborrow and before CX, and wrap the lifetime in a loop. Negative control: X c before borrowing and X c after return for explicit cleanup must still reject each one-CX lifetime, including with a correctly bound certificate. This is a reachable-state proof requirement, not permission to merge frames across H or waive a return.
